The preliminary proposal assumes we finance 90% of eligible invoices, with ordinary supplier recourse and no special funding or screening controls. Before I can make a binding decision on whether this launches and on what terms, I need to conduct our standard round-robin review. So I'd like to hear from credit risk, legal, and finance operations in turn. Who would like to start?
